text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, amiodarone hydrochloride 200 mg tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 144 tablets (9.8 days of supply) and Corvale General holds 268 tablets (17.8 days of supply). Both sites' inventory is labeled by Bryant Ranch Prepack (NDC 71335194204) and traces to FEI 1000519407.

Why (FDA record): FDA's most recent inspection of FEI 1000519407 ended 2026-07-16 and was classified VAI. The plant received an OAI classification in 2009 and a Warning Letter in 2010; subsequent inspections through 2026 have been VAI.

Our position: Current inventory at Corvale East is below the 14-day target. Corvale General has sufficient stock to support a transfer. Alternative manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list and their labels do not identify a traceable plant.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 57 tablets of 200 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval.
2. Monitor daily usage at both sites and re-evaluate transfer needs weekly — needs pharmacy director approval.
3. Continue sourcing from current labeled supplier (Bryant Ranch Prepack / FEI 1000519407) while VAI status holds — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: Purchasing from Advagen Pharma Limited, Aurobindo Pharma Limited, AvPAK, or Chartwell RX, LLC at this time due to lack of plant traceability and no FDA shortage listing to justify emergency procurement.
